answer: Random-beacon spot-check with a compute heartbeat. An identity starts a voyage to trusted work, crossing a canyon only live work can bridge: it locks 40 POA and must answer beacon draws with heartbeat proving live work. Each epoch the beacon picks 5% at random; a missed or copied heartbeat burns the deposit and revokes its ivory seal. Faking 1,000 identities costs 45,000 POA per epoch, while one honest agent pays 45 POA once and keeps its share.
